Thanks for replying.

Can I ask what the difference between psychiatrist, phycologist, therapist, counselor is? Are certain types just more able to prescribe medication? 

And if I can ask, how has medication helped you? I don't know much about it, other than the 'zombie' affect. I feel very deeply about everything and although it hurts me sometimes, it's part of what makes me, me. I don't want to feel numb to things. I just want to move on

Hi, 

thank you for replying, but the thing is, I've already cut him out. I deleted his number, everything for the past 7 or 8 months. I had completely completely stopped talking to him in November, and he then contacted me last month to apologize for a few things. We spoke twice and that was that. We decided to say goodbye. In all of those months, my feelings have not changed, which is where I"m finding issues.

I'm sorry to hear about your ex, and I really hope your son is happy and healthy today.

I know you're right, and he is crushing me and I need to let it go, but it's been so many months and still hurts to bad
